question: Should this maintainer-amended external PR proceed with test-only proof, or should it wait for live CDP tab-list evidence and an explicit decision on missing-type targets?
rationale: The diff is small and source-backed, but the PR changes fallback behavior and the contributor proof does not show the real browser path required for external PRs.

options.title: Ask for live CDP proof
options.body: Require redacted live output, logs, terminal screenshot, or recording showing a real page plus worker/service_worker targets where only the page remains selectable.

options.title: Override proof after maintainer acceptance
options.body: A maintainer can accept the strict `TargetInfo.type` contract and override the proof gate if test coverage is sufficient for this amended branch.

options.title: Preserve missing-type fallback
options.body: Change the filter to reject known non-page types while keeping URL-only behavior for targets that omit `type`.

recommendation.title: Ask for live CDP proof
recommendation.body: Require redacted live output, logs, terminal screenshot, or recording showing a real page plus worker/service_worker targets where only the page remains selectable.

likelyOwner.reason: He owns the current main history for this browser tab-filter surface and authored the stricter amendment on the PR branch.
